title: BaselineObservabilityVolumeCommissioningSchema
description: Validation schema defining volume-based secondary-zone observability proof, replacing point-based target checks with a 3D spatial measurement grid.
volume_observability_mandate: A single physical target placed at 20m does NOT prove observability across the entire cross-aisle corridor. Commissioning Gate C4 mandates a spatial volumetric sweep across a 3D grid covering the entire 20m depth extent, width clearance, and human height envelope.

physical_target_specification.contrast_standard: ISO 12233 slanted-edge resolution patch on torso

optical_resolution_acceptance_target.rationale: Ensures >= 30 pixels across human torso width (0.45m) at maximum 20m depth extent, meeting ByteTrack detection reliability thresholds.

geometric_obstruction_metric.definition: Projected area of secondary vehicle diversion trajectory corridor occluded by permanent physical facility structures (racks, columns, conduit).
geometric_obstruction_metric.reconciliation_note: Replaces undefined 'zero blind pockets' with rigorous metric: CRITICAL_OBSTRUCTION_AREA = 0. Zero unobserved floor area > 0.25 m^2 permitted within the 2.0m dynamic vehicle corridor up to 20m depth.

occlusion_state_taxonomy.CLEAR_BASELINE: All 36 grid points visible; CRITICAL_OBSTRUCTION_AREA == 0; Gate C4 PASS.
occlusion_state_taxonomy.PARTIAL_OCCLUSION: Minor edge vignetting behind non-structural posts; depth >= 20m maintained; conditional pass.
occlusion_state_taxonomy.HEAVY_OCCLUSION: Pallet overhangs or pillars occlude > 15% of corridor area; Gate C4 FAIL.
occlusion_state_taxonomy.UNKNOWN_OBSERVABILITY: Physical volumetric target sweep has not been performed; initial state.
